Name: Cheaper Staircases
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Is Mr. Qi's challange too much for you? Do you want to reach level 300? Then this mod is right for you!

_____________

Changes the amount of stone required to craft staircases to the value set in the config. By default it's 20 stone.
You can also change how many staircases you get by crafting. This can be also set in the config
If you want to change these values in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Created for 1.6 but might work with older versions too
